requirements: Confirm fork head and clean checkout. This adds a module and changes dependencies, and its new module lockfile has not been generated on Windows. Run the required dependency/license resolution in a separate scratch checkout using ./gradlew updateLicenses resolveAndLockAll --write-locks, record exact command/exit and preserve all generated diffs including untracked lockfiles. Do not amend or silently use a modified head as exact-head proof; if changes are required, verdict incomplete/failed and return patches for a new pushed head and gate.

On the unmodified exact head run ./gradlew :solr:test-framework:test --tests org.apache.solr.embedded.JettyMetricsBridgePrototypeTest -Ptests.seed=18616, record actual test counts, failures and fresh XML. Test includes prior prototype and new server metrics bridge.

Build distribution with ./gradlew dev; start a fresh user-managed node from solr/packaging/build/dev using an isolated port and temporary home; issue a successful GET to /solr/admin/info/system and a PUT to a nonexistent path outside /solr; scrape /solr/admin/metrics and verify solr_jetty_requests_total has GET and PUT labels, solr_jetty_responses_total has the 4xx label with increased value, and solr_jetty_threads exposes current, idle, max, queued. Capture exact commands, response codes, before/after metrics, startup logs, and prove installed handler jar was loaded across server/webapp classloaders. Stop node and retain logs. No smoke leg may pass on a modified checkout or an endpoint that never started.

Run ./gradlew tidy; require no tracked changes and capture diff otherwise. Run ./gradlew check -x test; preserve exits and complete logs. Any lock, source or formatting repair requires a new pushed head and superseding exact-head gate.

Report startup, compilation, packaging, assertions and environment failures separately; no retry without diagnosing. Production async, all verbs/status classes, disabled metrics and shutdown lifecycle remain gaps unless explicitly tested; do not overstate proof.
